title: feat: add session management MCP resources (Issue #16)
head: feat/session-management
body:
## Summary

Closes #16

This PR adds dedicated MCP resources for session management in the ORCa project, following the same pattern as the existing content extraction tools.

## Changes

### New MCP Resources (`src/mcp/server.ts`)

- **`browser_session_traces`** — Lists Playwright trace zip files for a user session (`GET /sessions/{userId}/traces`)
- **`browser_session_trace_download`** — Downloads a specific trace file (`GET /sessions/{userId}/traces/{filename}`)
- **`browser_session_trace_delete`** — Deletes a trace file (`DELETE /sessions/{userId}/traces/{filename}`)
- **`browser_session_destroy`** — Destroys a user session and cleans up state (`DELETE /sessions/{userId}`)

Each resource:
- Routes through the existing `OrcClient` which handles the HTTP call to the OpenAPI spec endpoint
- Generates a CLI command string in the format `sessions <func> --userId <userId> [--filename <filename>]`
- Is registered as a dedicated MCP tool with its own Zod input schema
- Includes proper error handling via `OrcSpecError`

### Tests (`tests/mcp/session-management-test.ts`)

21 automated tests covering:
- Endpoint configuration validation (5 tests)
- Command generation logic (6 tests)
- Input parsing for session management commands (5 tests)
- Round-trip integration tests (5 tests)

All tests pass: 21 passed, 0 failed.

## Files Changed

- `src/mcp/server.ts` — Added session management endpoint configs, `execSessionManagement()` function, and tool registration loop
- `tests/mcp/session-management-test.ts` — New test file with 21 tests
